newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 14.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 14.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:

* On Thursday, the Dow index fell 160.48 points to close at 6,878.89 --the fifth steepest fall in point terms in the history of the average after upbeat U.S. economic data revived fears of a rate hike by the Federal Reserve.

* Indonesian banks and joint-venture banks operating in Indonesia are only allowed by the central bank to disburse loans amounting to around 63 trillion rupiah, which is not a significant increase compared with last year's allocation of 58 trillion rupiah, senior banker Rijanto said in the Bisnis Indonesia newspaper.
* On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index ended 12.62 points lower at 669.99 points.
* On Friday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,401.30/401.60 at 0215 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,400.50/01.50
* Cigarette maker Sampoerna and noodle maker Indofood on reports that Sampoerna's president director Putra Sampoerna planned to take a 15-percent stake in Indofood.
* Chemical firm Aneka and sorbitol manufacturer Sorini on reports of sharp declines in 1996 net profits.
* Bank stocks Bank PDFCI, Bank Papan Sejahtera and Bank Ficorinvest, Bank BNI, Bank Internasional Indonesia on reports the central bank, Bank Indonesia, has sought to curb loan growth.
